evidence.title: How a multibillion-dollar oilfield has ignited the UK-Argentina feud over the Falklands

occurrences.checkable_against: Official histories and military records of the 1982 Falklands War
occurrences.quote_span: In 1982, the dispute over the islands' sovereignty led to a war between the UK and Argentina, though British control was quickly restored after Argentine forces invaded the islands.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Sea Lion oil project

occurrences.checkable_against: Falkland Islands government population statistics
occurrences.quote_span: Home to fewer than 4,000 people and located in an isolated corner of the South Atlantic Ocean, the Falkland Islands don't often feature in global business headlines.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Sea Lion oil project

occurrences.checkable_against: Navitas Petroleum and Rockhopper Exploration Sea Lion development plan
occurrences.quote_span: The companies plan to begin extracting oil from the Sea Lion oilfield by early 2028.
occurrences.speaker: Navitas Petroleum and Rockhopper Exploration
occurrences.subject: Sea Lion oil project

occurrences.checkable_against: Falkland Islands government leadership records
occurrences.quote_span: Andrea Clausen, chief executive of the Falklands since 2025, recently described this campaign as "economic warfare."
occurrences.speaker: Andrea Clausen
occurrences.subject: Sea Lion oil project

occurrences.checkable_against: Argentine government statements and historical records of the Falklands sovereignty claim
occurrences.quote_span: Argentina has laid claim to the islands, which it calls Las Malvinas, for two centuries.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Sea Lion oil project

occurrences.checkable_against: Javier Milei's September 2026 public address or official statement on the Sea Lion project
occurrences.quote_span: Last month, Argentine President Javier Milei threatened to launch an international legal challenge against the UK unless the project was stopped within two weeks.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Sea Lion oil project

occurrences.checkable_against: Navitas Petroleum and Rockhopper Exploration project records and Falkland Islands Legislative Assembly records
occurrences.quote_span: The oil project is being run by Israeli company Navitas Petroleum and the UK's Rockhopper Exploration and has the full support of the Falkand Islands Legislative Assembly, which has pursued the project since 2010.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Sea Lion oil project

occurrences.checkable_against: Falkland Islands administration policy documents
occurrences.quote_span: The administration is even looking into the possibility of creating a sovereign wealth fund if the oil project is successful.
occurrences.speaker: Falkland Islands administration
occurrences.subject: Sea Lion oil project

occurrences.checkable_against: Supplier and shipping company contracts, refusals and Falkland Islands supply records
occurrences.quote_span: Many international suppliers and shipping companies already refuse to supply the Falklands for fear of angering Argentina.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Sea Lion oil project

occurrences.checkable_against: Javier Milei's statement and International Tribunal for the Law of the Sea filings
occurrences.quote_span: Milei says the project is "the illegal plundering of our resources" and that he will take the matter to the International Tribunal for the Law of the Sea, an independent judicial body responsible for the application of the United Nations' Convention on the Law of the Sea.
occurrences.speaker: Javier Milei
occurrences.subject: Sea Lion oil project

occurrences.checkable_against: Falkland Islands national accounts and sectoral GDP data
occurrences.quote_span: That would substantially increase the Falklands' current annual GDP, which is almost entirely dependent on the volatile fishing sector and tourism.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Sea Lion oil project

occurrences.checkable_against: Sea Lion field development plan and reserve-life projections
occurrences.quote_span: The companies hope that at its peak, the field will produce up to 50,000 barrels per day and could last for up to 35 years.
occurrences.speaker: Navitas Petroleum and Rockhopper Exploration
occurrences.subject: Sea Lion oil project

occurrences.checkable_against: 2013 Falkland Islands referendum results
occurrences.quote_span: A 2013 sovereignty referendum on the islands returned a 99.8% vote in favor of remaining tied to the UK as a self-governing British Overseas Territory.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Sea Lion oil project

occurrences.checkable_against: Falkland Islands Legislative Assembly membership records
occurrences.quote_span: Stacy Bragger, a member of the Falklands Islands' 12-member assembly, told DW that the dispute was "nothing new" and that Argentina is using the oil project as "a vehicle to pursue their sovereignty claim."
occurrences.speaker: Stacy Bragger
occurrences.subject: Sea Lion oil project

occurrences.checkable_against: Sea Lion project financing records and 2014 and 2020 project status announcements
occurrences.quote_span: Such a move could cast doubt on the project, which previously collapsed in 2014 and 2020, due to financing troubles, oil-price weakness and delays caused by sanctions.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Sea Lion oil project

occurrences.checkable_against: Sea Lion oil project budget and financial projections
occurrences.quote_span: The project has a budget of $1.8 billion (€1.6 billion) and could generate revenues of more than double that for the Falkland Islands.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Sea Lion oil project
